episode: S01E01 The One Where Monica Gets a New Roommate (The Pilot-The Extended Version)

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: There's nothing to tell! He's just some guy I work with!
lines.zh: 没什么好说的！他只是我工作上的一个同事！

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: C'mon, you're going out with the guy! There's gotta be something wrong with him!
lines.zh: 拜托，你要跟他出去约会！他肯定有问题！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right Joey, be nice. So does he have a hump? A hump and a hairpiece?
lines.zh: 好了乔伊，友好点。那他有驼背吗？又驼背又戴假发？

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, does he eat chalk?
lines.zh: 等等，他吃粉笔吗？

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Just, 'cause, I don't want her to go through what I went through with Carl- oh!
lines.zh: 我只是不想让她经历我和卡尔那件事——哦！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, everybody relax. This is not even a date. It's just two people going out to dinner and- not having sex.
lines.zh: 好了，大家都放松。这甚至不是约会。只是两个人出去吃顿饭——而且不上床。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sounds like a date to me.
lines.zh: 听起来就像约会。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Alright, so I'm back in high school, I'm standing in the middle of the cafeteria, and I realize I am totally naked.
lines.zh: 好吧，我又回到高中，站在食堂中间，突然发现自己全裸了。

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Oh, yeah. Had that dream.
lines.zh: 哦对，做过那个梦。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Then I look down, and I realize there's a phone... there.
lines.zh: 然后我低头一看，发现那里有个电话……

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Instead of...?
lines.zh: 而不是……？

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That's right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Never had that dream.
lines.zh: 我从没做过那个梦。

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No.
lines.zh: 没有。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All of a sudden, the phone starts to ring. Now I don't know what to do, everybody starts looking at me.
lines.zh: 突然电话响了。我不知道该怎么办，所有人都开始看着我。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And they weren't looking at you before?!
lines.zh: 那他们之前没在看你吗？！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Finally, I figure I'd better answer it, and it turns out it's my mother, which is very-very weird, because- she never calls me!
lines.zh: 最后我想我最好接一下，结果是我妈打来的，这非常非常奇怪，因为她从不给我打电话！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.
lines.zh: 嗨。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: This guy says hello, I wanna kill myself.
lines.zh: 这家伙说声嗨，我就想自杀。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are you okay, sweetie?
lines.zh: 你还好吗，亲爱的？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just feel like someone reached down my throat, grabbed my small intestine, pulled it out of my mouth and tied it around my neck...
lines.zh: 我感觉就像有人把手伸进我喉咙，抓住我的小肠，从嘴里拽出来，然后系在我脖子上……

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Cookie?
lines.zh: 要饼干吗？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Carol moved her stuff out today.
lines.zh: 卡萝尔今天把东西搬走了。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ohh.
lines.zh: 噢。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Let me get you some coffee.
lines.zh: 我给你倒杯咖啡。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Thanks.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh! Oh!
lines.zh: 噢！噢！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, no don't! Stop cleansing my aura! No, just leave my aura alone, okay?
lines.zh: 不，别！别净化我的气场！别碰我的气场，好吗？

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Fine! Be murky!
lines.zh: 好吧！继续浑浊吧！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll be fine, alright? Really, everyone. I hope she'll be very happy.
lines.zh: 我会没事的，好吗？真的，大家。我希望她会很幸福。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: No you don't.
lines.zh: 你才不希望。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No I don't, to hell with her, she left me!
lines.zh: 对，我不希望，去她的，她甩了我！

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And you never knew she was a lesbian...
lines.zh: 你一直都不知道她是同性恋……

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No!! Okay?! Why does everyone keep fixating on that? She didn't know, how should I know?
lines.zh: 不知道！！好吗？！为什么大家都揪着这个不放？她自己都不知道，我怎么知道？

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Sometimes I wish I was a lesbian... Did I say that out loud?
lines.zh: 有时候我真希望我是个女同性恋……我是不是说出来了？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I told mom and dad last night, they seemed to take it pretty well.
lines.zh: 我昨晚告诉爸妈了，他们看起来还挺能接受的。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh really, so that hysterical phone call I got from a woman at sobbing 3:00 A.M., "I'll never have grandchildren, I'll never have grandchildren." was what? A wrong number?
lines.zh: 哦真的吗？那我凌晨三点接到一个女人哭着打电话说「我永远不会有孙子了，我永远不会有孙子了」是怎么回事？打错了？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Sorry.
lines.zh: 抱歉。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Alright Ross, look. You're feeling a lot of pain right now. You're angry. You're hurting. Can I tell you what the answer is?
lines.zh: 好了罗斯，听着。你现在很痛苦。你很生气。你很受伤。我能告诉你答案是什么吗？

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Strip joint! C'mon, you're single! Have some hormones!
lines.zh: 脱衣舞俱乐部！拜托，你现在单身了！释放点荷尔蒙吧！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I don't want to be single, okay? I just... I just- I just wanna be married again!
lines.zh: 我不想单身，好吗？我只是……我只是……我只是想再结一次婚！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And I just want a million dollars!
lines.zh: 而我只想要一百万美元！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel?!
lines.zh: 瑞秋？！

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God Monica hi! Thank God! I just went to your building and you weren't there and then this guy with a big hammer said you might be here and you are, you are!
lines.zh: 天啊莫妮卡嗨！谢天谢地！我刚去了你住的地方你不在，然后一个拿大锤子的人说你可能在这儿，你真的在，你真的在！

lines.speaker: Waitress
lines.text: Can I get you some coffee?
lines.zh: 要给您来杯咖啡吗？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: De-caff. Okay, everybody, this is Rachel, another Lincoln High survivor. This is everybody, this is Chandler, and Phoebe, and Joey, and- you remember my brother Ross?
lines.zh: 无咖啡因的。好了，各位，这是瑞秋，又一个林肯高中幸存者。这是大家，这是钱德勒、菲比、乔伊——你还记得我哥哥罗斯吧？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hi, sure!
lines.zh: 嗨，当然记得！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Hi.
lines.zh: 嗨。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So you wanna tell us now, or are we waiting for four wet bridesmaids?
lines.zh: 你是现在告诉我们，还是等四个湿漉漉的伴娘过来？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh God... well, it started about a half hour before the wedding. I was in the room where we were keeping all the presents, and I was looking at this gravy boat. This really gorgeous Lamauge gravy boat. When all of a sudden- Sweet 'n' Lo?- I realized that I was more turned on by this gravy boat than by Barry! And then I got really freaked out, and that's when it hit me: how much Barry looks like Mr. Potato Head. You know, I mean, I always knew looked familiar, but... Anyway, I just had to get out of there, and I started wondering 'Why am I doing this, and who am I doing this for?'. So anyway I just didn't know where to go, and I know that you and I have kinda drifted apart, but you're the only person I knew who lived here in the city.
lines.zh: 天啊……事情是从婚礼前半小时开始的。我在放礼物的房间里，看着这个酱汁船。一个特别漂亮的Lamauge酱汁船。突然——要甜味剂吗？——我意识到我对这个酱汁船的兴趣比对巴里还大！然后我吓坏了，突然意识到巴里长得有多像土豆先生。我一直觉得他很眼熟，但是……总之，我必须离开那里，我开始想「我为什么要这么做，我是为了谁这么做？」。反正我不知道该去哪儿，我知道我们有点疏远了，但你是我认识的唯一住在这座城市的人。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Who wasn't invited to the wedding.
lines.zh: 而且没被邀请参加婚礼的人。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ooh, I was kinda hoping that wouldn't be an issue...
lines.zh: 噢，我本来希望这不是问题……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Now I'm guessing that he bought her the big pipe organ, and she's really not happy about it.
lines.zh: 我猜他给她买了大管风琴，她很不高兴。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Tuna or egg salad? Decide!
lines.zh: 金枪鱼还是鸡蛋沙拉？快决定！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'll have whatever Christine is having.
lines.zh: 克里斯汀点什么我就点什么。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Daddy, I just... I can't marry him! I'm sorry. I just don't love him. Well, it matters to me!
lines.zh: 爸爸，我……我不能嫁给他！对不起。我只是不爱他。这对我很重要！

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: If I let go of my hair, my head will fall off.
lines.zh: 如果我放开头发，我的头会掉下来。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, she should not be wearing those pants.
lines.zh: 噢，她不该穿那条裤子。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I say push her down the stairs.
lines.zh: 我说把她推下楼梯。

lines.speaker: Phoebe, Ross, Chandler, and Joey
lines.text: Push her down the stairs! Push her down the stairs! Push her down the stairs!
lines.zh: 把她推下楼梯！把她推下楼梯！把她推下楼梯！

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: C'mon Daddy, listen to me! It's like, it's like, all of my life, everyone has always told me, 'You're a shoe! You're a shoe, you're a shoe, you're a shoe!'. And today I just stopped and I said, 'What if I don't wanna be a shoe? What if I wanna be a- a purse, you know? Or a- or a hat! No, I'm not saying I want you to buy me a hat, I'm saying I am a ha- It's a metaphor, Daddy!
lines.zh: 拜托爸爸，听我说！就像，就像我这辈子所有人都一直告诉我「你是鞋子！你是鞋子，你是鞋子，你是鞋子！」。今天我停下来问自己「如果我不想当鞋子呢？如果我想当一个——一个手提包呢？或者一顶帽子！不，我不是说要你给我买帽子，我是说我是一顶帽——这是个比喻，爸爸！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You can see where he'd have trouble.
lines.zh: 你能理解他为什么会困惑了。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Look Daddy, it's my life. Well maybe I'll just stay here with Monica.
lines.zh: 听着爸爸，这是我的人生。也许我就待在这儿和莫妮卡一起住。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, I guess we've established who's staying here with Monica...
lines.zh: 好吧，我想我们已经确定谁要和莫妮卡一起住了……

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, maybe that's my decision. Well, maybe I don't need your money. Wait!! Wait, I said maybe!!
lines.zh: 也许这是我的决定。也许我不需要你的钱。等等！！等等，我说的是「也许」！！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Just breathe, breathe.. that's it. Just try to think of nice calm things...
lines.zh: 深呼吸，深呼吸……对。试着想想美好平静的事情……

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Raindrops on roses and rabbits and kittens, bluebells and sleighbells and- something with mittens... La la la la...something and noodles with string. These are a few...
lines.zh: 玫瑰上的雨滴、兔子和小猫，风信子和雪橇铃还有——带手套的什么……啦啦啦啦……什么和带线的面条。这些是一些……

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm all better now.
lines.zh: 我现在好多了。

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I helped!
lines.zh: 我帮上忙了！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, look, this is probably for the best, you know? Independence. Taking control of your life. The whole, 'hat' thing.
lines.zh: 好吧，听着，这可能是最好的结果，知道吗？独立。掌控自己的人生。整个「帽子」的事情。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: And hey, you need anything, you can always come to Joey. Me and Chandler live across the hall. And he's away a lot.
lines.zh: 嘿，你需要什么随时可以找乔伊。我和钱德勒住对面。而且他经常不在。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Joey, stop hitting on her! It's her wedding day!
lines.zh: 乔伊，别再勾搭她了！今天是她的婚礼日！

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What, like there's a rule or something?
lines.zh: 怎么，难道有规定吗？

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Please don't do that again, it's a horrible sound.
lines.zh: 请别再那样按了，声音太可怕了。

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: It's, uh, it's Paul.
lines.zh: 是，呃，是保罗。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God, is it 6:30? Buzz him in!
lines.zh: 天啊，已经六点半了吗？放他进来！

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Who's Paul?
lines.zh: 保罗是谁？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Paul the Wine Guy, Paul?
lines.zh: 葡萄酒保罗，保罗？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Maybe.
lines.zh: 也许吧。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Wait. Your 'not a real date' tonight is with Paul the Wine Guy?
lines.zh: 等等。你今晚「不是真正约会」的对象是葡萄酒保罗？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: He finally asked you out?
lines.zh: 他终于约你了？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yes!
lines.zh: 是的！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Ooh, this is a Dear Diary moment.
lines.zh: 噢，这是值得写进日记的时刻。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rach, wait, I can cancel...
lines.zh: 瑞，等等，我可以取消……

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Please, no, go, that'd be fine!
lines.zh: 拜托，不用，去吧，没关系！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Are, are you okay? I mean, do you want me to stay?
lines.zh: 你，你还好吗？我是说，你要我留下来吗？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That'd be good...
lines.zh: 那样也好……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Really?
lines.zh: 真的？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No, go on! It's Paul the Wine Guy!
lines.zh: 不，去吧！是葡萄酒保罗啊！

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What does that mean? Does he sell it, drink it, or just complain a lot?
lines.zh: 那是什么意思？他是卖酒、喝酒，还是只会抱怨？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hi, come in! Paul, this is.. everybody, everybody, this is Paul.
lines.zh: 嗨，请进！保罗，这是……大家，大家，这是保罗。

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Hey! Paul! Hi! The Wine Guy! Hey!
lines.zh: 嘿！保罗！嗨！葡萄酒哥！嘿！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I'm sorry, I didn't catch your name. Paul, was it?
lines.zh: 抱歉，我没听清你的名字。是保罗吗？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Okay, umm-umm, I'll just--I'll be right back, I just gotta go ah, go ah...
lines.zh: 好，嗯——嗯，我——我马上回来，我只是去啊，去啊……

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: A wandering?
lines.zh: 去闲逛？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Change! Okay, sit down. Two seconds.
lines.zh: 换衣服！好，坐下。两秒钟。

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ooh, I just pulled out four eyelashes. That can't be good.
lines.zh: 噢，我刚拔掉四根睫毛。这可不好。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey, Paul!
lines.zh: 嘿，保罗！

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Yeah?
lines.zh: 嗯？

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Here's a little tip, she really likes it when you rub her neck in the same spot over and over and over again until it starts to get a little red.
lines.zh: 给你个小提示，她特别喜欢你反复揉她脖子同一个地方，揉到开始有点红。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shut up, Joey!
lines.zh: 闭嘴，乔伊！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: So Rachel, what're you, uh... what're you up to tonight?
lines.zh: 那么瑞秋，你，呃……今晚有什么安排？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well, I was kinda supposed to be headed for Aruba on my honeymoon, so nothing!
lines.zh: 本来我应该去阿鲁巴度蜜月的，所以没什么！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Right, you're not even getting your honeymoon, God.. No, no, although, Aruba, this time of year... talk about your- big lizards... Anyway, if you don't feel like being alone tonight, Joey and Chandler are coming over to help me put together my new furniture.
lines.zh: 对，你连蜜月都没了，天啊……不，不，不过阿鲁巴这个季节……说起那些——大蜥蜴……总之，如果你今晚不想一个人待着，乔伊和钱德勒会过来帮我组装新家具。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, and we're very excited about it.
lines.zh: 是的，我们对此非常兴奋。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Well actually thanks, but I think I'm just gonna hang out here tonight. It's been kinda a long day.
lines.zh: 其实谢谢，但我想今晚就待在这儿。今天已经够长了。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay, sure.
lines.zh: 好，没问题。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey Pheebs, you wanna help?
lines.zh: 嘿菲比，你想帮忙吗？

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, I wish I could, but I don't want to.
lines.zh: 噢，我希望可以，但我不想。

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Love is sweet as summer showers, love is a wondrous work of art, but your love oh your love, your love...is like a giant pigeon...crapping on my heart. La-la-la-la-la- Thank you. La-la-la-la...ohhh!
lines.zh: 爱像夏日阵雨一样甜美，爱是奇妙的艺术作品，但你的爱噢你的爱，你的爱……就像一只巨大的鸽子……在我心上拉屎。啦啦啦啦啦——谢谢。啦啦啦啦……噢！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm supposed to attach a brackety thing to the side things, using a bunch of these little worm guys. I have no brackety thing, I see no whim guys whatsoever and- I cannot feel my legs.
lines.zh: 我应该用一堆这些小虫子一样的东西把一个支架装到侧板上。我没有支架，也完全看不到什么虫子，而且——我感觉不到我的腿了。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I'm thinking we've got a bookcase here.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们组装好一个书架了。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: It's a beautiful thing.
lines.zh: 真是件美丽的作品。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What's this?
lines.zh: 这是什么？

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I would have to say that is an 'L'-shaped bracket.
lines.zh: 我得说这是个L形支架。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Which goes where?
lines.zh: 装在哪里？

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: I have no idea.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Done with the bookcase!
lines.zh: 书架搞定！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All finished!
lines.zh: 全完成了！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: This was Carol's favorite beer. She always drank it out of the can, I should have known.
lines.zh: 这是卡萝尔最爱的啤酒。她总是直接喝罐装的，我早该知道。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Hey-hey-hey-hey, if you're gonna start with that stuff we're outta here.
lines.zh: 嘿嘿嘿嘿，你要是开始说这些我们可就走了。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Yes, please don't spoil all this fun.
lines.zh: 是的，请别破坏我们的乐趣。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Ross, let me ask you a question. She got the furniture, the stereo, the good TV- what did you get?
lines.zh: 罗斯，让我问你个问题。她拿走了家具、音响、好电视——你得到了什么？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You guys.
lines.zh: 你们。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, God.
lines.zh: 噢，天啊。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You got screwed.
lines.zh: 你被坑了。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh my God!
lines.zh: 噢我的天！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh my God!
lines.zh: 噢我的天！

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: I know, I know, I'm such an idiot. I guess I should have caught on when she started going to the dentist four and five times a week. I mean, how clean can teeth get?
lines.zh: 我知道，我知道，我真是个白痴。她开始一周去牙医四五次的时候我就该察觉了。牙齿能有多干净？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: My brother's going through that right now, he's such a mess. How did you get through it?
lines.zh: 我哥哥现在也正在经历这个，他一团糟。你是怎么挺过来的？

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well, you might try accidentally breaking something valuable of hers, say her-
lines.zh: 你可以试着不小心弄坏她的贵重东西，比如说她的——

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: -leg?

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: That's one way! Me, I- I went for the watch.
lines.zh: 那是一种方法！我——我选择了手表。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You actually broke her watch? Wow! The worst thing I ever did was, I-I shredded by boyfriend's favorite bath towel.
lines.zh: 你真的弄坏了她的手表？哇！我做过最坏的事是把前男友最爱的浴巾撕成了碎片。

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ooh, steer clear of you.
lines.zh: 噢，得离你远点。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Barry, I'm sorry... I am so sorry... I know you probably think that this is all about what I said the other day about you making love with your socks on, but it isn't... it isn't, it's about me, and I ju- Hi, machine cut me off again... anyway...look, look, I know that some girl is going to be incredibly lucky to become Mrs. Barry Finkel, but it isn't me, it's not me. And not that I have any idea who me is right now, but you just have to give me a chance too...
lines.zh: 巴里，对不起……我真的很抱歉……我知道你可能以为这全是因为前几天我说你穿着袜子做爱的事，但不是……不是的，是关于我，我只是——嗨，留言机又把我切断了……总之……听着，听着，我知道某个女孩会非常幸运成为巴里·芬克尔夫人，但那不是我，不是我。虽然我现在也不知道我是谁，但你也得给我一个机会……

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I'm divorced! I'm only 26 and I'm divorced!
lines.zh: 我离婚了！我才26岁就离婚了！

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Shut up!
lines.zh: 闭嘴！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You must stop!
lines.zh: 你必须停下来！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: That only took me an hour.
lines.zh: 那只花了我一个小时。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Look, Ross, you gotta understand, between us we haven't had a relationship that has lasted longer than a Mento. You, however, have had the love of a woman for four years. Four years of closeness and sharing at the end of which she ripped your heart out, and that is why we don't do it! I don't think that was my point!
lines.zh: 听着罗斯，你得明白，我们俩加起来都没有一段关系能超过一颗薄荷糖的时间。而你却拥有了一个女人四年的爱。四年的亲密和分享，最后她把你的心撕了出来，这就是为什么我们不谈恋爱！我觉得那不是我的重点！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know what the scariest part is? What if there's only one woman for everybody, you know? I mean what if you get one woman- and that's it? Unfortunately in my case, there was only one woman- for her...
lines.zh: 你知道最可怕的是什么吗？如果每个人只有一个女人怎么办？我是说如果你得到一个女人——就这样了？不幸的是在我这里，只有一个女人——是给她的……

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: What are you talking about? 'One woman'? That's like saying there's only one flavor of ice cream for you. Lemme tell you something, Ross. There's lots of flavors out there. There's Rocky Road, and Cookie Dough, and Bing! Cherry Vanilla. You could get 'em with Jimmies, or nuts, or whipped cream! This is the best thing that ever happened to you! You got married, you were, like, what, eight? Welcome back to the world! Grab a spoon!
lines.zh: 你在说什么？「一个女人」？那就好像说你只有一种冰淇淋口味。让我告诉你，罗斯。外面有很多口味。有落基路、曲奇面团，还有砰！樱桃香草。你可以加糖针、坚果或奶油！这是发生在你身上最好的事！你结婚的时候，大概才八岁吧？欢迎回到这个世界！拿起勺子吧！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I honestly don't know if I'm hungry or horny.
lines.zh: 我真的不知道我是饿了还是饥渴了。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Stay out of my freezer!
lines.zh: 离我的冰箱远点！

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Ever since she walked out on me, I, uh...
lines.zh: 自从她离开我之后，我，呃……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What?..... What, you wanna spell it out with noodles?
lines.zh: 什么？……怎么，你想用面条拼出来吗？

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: No, it's, it's more of a fifth date kinda revelation.
lines.zh: 不，这更像是第五次约会才说的那种事。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh, so there is gonna be a fifth date?
lines.zh: 哦，所以会有第五次约会？

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Isn't there?
lines.zh: 不是吗？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah... yeah, I think there is. -What were you gonna say?
lines.zh: 是……是，我觉得会有。——你刚才想说什么？

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Well, ever-ev-... ever since she left me, um, I haven't been able to, uh, perform. ...Sexually.
lines.zh: 嗯，自从她离开我之后，嗯，我一直无法，呃，表现。……在性方面。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh God, oh God, I am sorry... I am so sorry...
lines.zh: 天啊，天啊，对不起……我真的很抱歉……

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: It's okay...
lines.zh: 没关系……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know being spit on is probably not what you need right now. Um... how long?
lines.zh: 我知道被喷到可能不是你现在需要的。嗯……多久了？

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Two years.
lines.zh: 两年。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Wow! I'm-I'm-I'm glad you smashed her watch!
lines.zh: 哇！我——我——我很高兴你砸了她的手表！

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: So you still think you, um... might want that fifth date?
lines.zh: 那你还觉得你，嗯……可能想要那第五次约会吗？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, I do.
lines.zh: 是。是，我想。

lines.speaker: Priest (Al) on TV
lines.text: We are gathered here today to join Joanie Louise Cunningham and Charles, Chachi-Chachi-Chachi, Arcola in the bound of holy matrimony.
lines.zh: 我们今天聚集在这里，将琼妮·路易斯·坎宁安和查尔斯，查奇-查奇-查奇，阿科拉结合在神圣的婚姻中。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, see... but Joanie loved Chachi! That's the difference!
lines.zh: 哦，看……但琼妮爱查奇！那就是区别！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Grab a spoon. Do you know how long it's been since I've grabbed a spoon? Do the words 'Billy, don't be a hero' mean anything to you?
lines.zh: 拿起勺子。你知道我有多久没拿起勺子了吗？「比利，别当英雄」这句话对你有意义吗？

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Great story! But, I uh, I gotta go, I got a date with Andrea--Angela--Andrea... Oh, man.
lines.zh: 好故事！但是，我呃，我得走了，我约了安德莉亚——安吉拉——安德莉亚……噢，天。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Angela's the screamer, Andrea has cats.
lines.zh: 安吉拉是那个会尖叫的，安德莉亚有猫。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Right. Thanks. It's Julie. I'm outta here.
lines.zh: 对。谢谢。是朱莉。我走了。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You know, here's the thing. Even if I could get it together enough to- to ask a woman out,... who am I gonna ask?
lines.zh: 你知道，事情是这样的。即使我能鼓起勇气去——去约一个女人，……我要约谁呢？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Isn't this amazing? I mean, I have never made coffee before in my entire life.
lines.zh: 这不是很神奇吗？我是说，我这辈子从没做过咖啡。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: That is amazing.
lines.zh: 确实神奇。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Congratulations.
lines.zh: 恭喜。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know, I figure if I can make coffee, there isn't anything I can't do.
lines.zh: 我觉得如果我能做咖啡，就没有什么事是我做不到的。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: No, I think it's, "If can invade Poland, there isn't anything I can't do.
lines.zh: 不，我觉得是「如果能入侵波兰，就没有什么事是我做不到的」。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Listen, while you're on a roll, if you feel like you gotta make like a Western omelet or something... Although actually I'm really not that hungry...
lines.zh: 听着，趁你势头正盛，如果你想做个西式煎蛋卷什么的……不过其实我真的不太饿……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh good, Lenny and Squiggy are here.
lines.zh: 哦好，伦尼和斯奎吉来了。

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Morning. Good morning.
lines.zh: 早。早上好。

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Morning.
lines.zh: 早。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Morning, Paul.
lines.zh: 早，保罗。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hello, Paul.
lines.zh: 你好，保罗。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Hi, Paul, is it?
lines.zh: 嗨，保罗，是吗？

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Thank you! Thank you so much!
lines.zh: 谢谢！非常感谢！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Stop!
lines.zh: 停！

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: No, I'm telling you last night was like, um, all my birthdays, both graduations, plus the barn raising scene in Witness.
lines.zh: 不，我告诉你昨晚就像，嗯，我所有的生日、两次毕业典礼，加上《证人》里盖谷仓的场景。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: We'll talk later.
lines.zh: 我们稍后聊。

lines.speaker: Paul
lines.text: Yeah. Thank you.
lines.zh: 好。谢谢。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: That wasn't a real date?! What the hell do you do on a real date?
lines.zh: 那还不是真正的约会？！那真正的约会你们干什么？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Shut up, and put my table back.
lines.zh: 闭嘴，把我的桌子放回去。

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Okayyy!
lines.zh: 好——的！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: All right, kids, I gotta get to work. If I don't input those numbers,... it doesn't make much of a difference...
lines.zh: 好了孩子们，我得去上班了。如果我不输入那些数字……也没什么大不了的……

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: So, like, you guys all have jobs?
lines.zh: 所以，你们大家都有工作？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Yeah, we all have jobs. See, that's how we buy stuff.
lines.zh: 是的，我们都有工作。看，我们就是这样买东西的。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Yeah, I'm an actor.
lines.zh: 是的，我是演员。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Wow! Would I have seen you in anything?
lines.zh: 哇！我在什么作品里见过你吗？

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I doubt it. Mostly regional work.
lines.zh: 我怀疑。大多是地方剧。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Oh wait, wait, unless you happened to catch the Reruns' production of Pinocchio, at the little theater in the park.
lines.zh: 哦等等，除非你碰巧看过公园小剧场重演团的《匹诺曹》。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Look, it was a job all right?
lines.zh: 听着，那也是工作好吗？

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: 'Look, Gippetto, I'm a real live boy.'
lines.zh: 「看啊，杰佩托，我是个真正的男孩了。」

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I will not take this abuse.
lines.zh: 我不会忍受这种虐待。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You're right, I'm sorry. Once I was a wooden boy, a little wooden boy...
lines.zh: 你说得对，对不起。从前我是个木头男孩，一个小小的木头男孩……

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: You should both know that he's a dead man. Oh, Chandler?
lines.zh: 你们俩都该知道他死定了。噢，钱德勒？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: So how you doing today? Did you sleep okay? Talk to Barry? I can't stop smiling.
lines.zh: 你今天怎么样？睡得好吗？和巴里谈过了吗？我笑得停不下来。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I can see that. You look like you slept with a hanger in your mouth.
lines.zh: 我看出来了。你看起来像嘴里塞了个衣架睡觉。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I know, he's just so, so... Do you remember you and Tony DeMarco?
lines.zh: 我知道，他就是那么，那么……你还记得你和托尼·德马科吗？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, yeah.
lines.zh: 哦，记得。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, it's like that. With feelings.
lines.zh: 就像那样。但有感觉。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, wow. Are you in trouble.
lines.zh: 噢，哇。你有麻烦了。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Big time!
lines.zh: 大麻烦！

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Want a wedding dress? Hardly used.
lines.zh: 要婚纱吗？几乎没穿过。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I think we are getting a little ahead of ourselves here. Okay. Okay. I am just going to get up, go to work and not think about him all day. Or else I'm just gonna get up and go to work.
lines.zh: 我觉得我们有点想太远了。好。好。我只是要起床、去上班，整天不想他。或者我只是起床去上班。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, look, wish me luck!
lines.zh: 哦，看，祝我好运！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What for?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm gonna go get one of those job things.
lines.zh: 我要去找一份那种「工作」东西。

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: Hey, Monica!
lines.zh: 嘿，莫妮卡！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Hey Frannie, welcome back! How was Florida?
lines.zh: 嘿弗兰妮，欢迎回来！佛罗里达怎么样？

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: You had sex, didn't you?
lines.zh: 你做爱了，对吧？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How do you do that?
lines.zh: 你怎么知道的？

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: Oh, I hate you. I'm pushing my Aunt Roz through Parrot Jungle and you're having sex! So? Who?
lines.zh: 噢，我恨你。我推着罗兹姨妈逛鹦鹉丛林，你却在做爱！所以？是谁？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You know Paul?
lines.zh: 你认识保罗吗？

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: Paul the Wine Guy? Oh yeah, I know Paul.
lines.zh: 葡萄酒保罗？哦是的，我认识保罗。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You mean you know Paul like I know Paul?
lines.zh: 你是说你像我认识保罗那样认识他？

lines.speaker: Frannie
lines.text: Are you kidding? I take credit for Paul. You know, before me, there was no snap in his turtle for two years.
lines.zh: 开玩笑吗？保罗是我的功劳。知道吗，在我之前，他那只乌龟两年都没动静了。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Of course it was a line!
lines.zh: 当然是句台词！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Why?! Why? Why, why would anybody do something like that?
lines.zh: 为什么？！为什么？为什么，为什么有人要那样做？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I assume we're looking for an answer more sophisticated than 'to get you into bed'.
lines.zh: 我猜我们在找一个比「为了把你弄上床」更高级的答案。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I hate men! I hate men!
lines.zh: 我恨男人！我恨男人！

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, no. Don't hate, you don't want to put that out into the universe.
lines.zh: 哦，不。别恨，你不想把那种情绪释放到宇宙中。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Is it me? Is it like I have some sort of beacon that only dogs and men with severe emotional problems can hear?
lines.zh: 是我的问题吗？是不是我身上有某种只有狗和有严重情感问题的男人才能听到的信号？

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: All right, c'mere, gimme your feet.
lines.zh: 好了，过来，把脚给我。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I just thought he was nice, you know?
lines.zh: 我只是觉得他人不错，知道吗？

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't believe you didn't know it was a line!
lines.zh: 我不敢相信你居然不知道那是句台词！

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Guess what?
lines.zh: 猜猜怎么着？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You got a job?
lines.zh: 你找到工作了？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Are you kidding? I'm trained for nothing! I was laughed out of twelve interviews today.
lines.zh: 开玩笑吗？我什么都不会！今天被十二场面试笑出来了。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: And yet you're surprisingly upbeat.
lines.zh: 但你还出奇地乐观。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You would be too if you found John and David boots on sale, fifty percent off!
lines.zh: 如果你发现John and David靴子打五折，你也会的！

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Oh, how well you know me...
lines.zh: 哦，你真了解我……

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: They're my new 'I don't need a job, I don't need my parents, I've got great boots' boots!
lines.zh: 这是我的新「我不需要工作、不需要父母、我有很棒的靴子」靴子！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: How'd you pay for them?
lines.zh: 你怎么付的钱？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Uh, credit card.
lines.zh: 呃，信用卡。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: And who pays for that?
lines.zh: 那谁付钱？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Um... my... father.
lines.zh: 嗯……我……爸爸。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Oh, God, come on you guys, is this really necessary? I mean, I can stop charging anytime I want.
lines.zh: 噢天啊，拜托你们，真的有必要吗？我是说，我随时可以停止刷卡。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: C'mon, you can't live off your parents your whole life.
lines.zh: 拜托，你不能一辈子靠父母生活。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I know that. That's why I was getting married.
lines.zh: 我知道。所以我才要结婚。

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Give her a break, it's hard being on your own for the first time.
lines.zh: 给她点时间，第一次独立很难。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Thank you.
lines.zh: 谢谢。

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You're welcome. I remember when I first came to this city. I was fourteen. My mom had just killed herself and my step-dad was back in prison, and I got here, and I didn't know anybody. And I ended up living with this albino guy who was, like, cleaning windshields outside port authority, and then he killed himself, and then I found aromatherapy. So believe me, I know exactly how you feel.
lines.zh: 不客气。我记得我第一次来这座城市的时候。我十四岁。我妈妈刚自杀，继父又进了监狱，我来到这里，一个人都不认识。后来我和一个在港务局外擦挡风玻璃的白化病家伙住在一起，然后他也自杀了，然后我找到了芳香疗法。所以相信我，我完全知道你的感受。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: The word you're looking for is 'Anyway'...
lines.zh: 你要找的词是「总之」……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: All right, you ready?
lines.zh: 好了，你准备好了吗？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No. No, no, I'm not ready! How can I be ready? "Hey, Rach! You ready to jump out the airplane without your parachute?" Come on, I can't do this!
lines.zh: 不。不，不，我没准备好！我怎么准备好？「嘿，瑞！准备好不带降落伞跳出飞机了吗？」拜托，我做不到！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You can, I know you can!
lines.zh: 你可以，我知道你可以！

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I don't think so.
lines.zh: 我不这么认为。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Come on, you made coffee! You can do anything!
lines.zh: 拜托，你做过咖啡了！你可以做任何事！

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: C'mon, cut. Cut, cut, cut,...
lines.zh: 来吧，剪。剪，剪，剪……

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Cut, cut, cut, cut, cut, cut, cut...
lines.zh: 剪，剪，剪，剪，剪，剪，剪……

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: You know what? I think we can just leave it at that. It's kinda like a symbolic gesture...
lines.zh: 你知道吗？我觉得可以到此为止了。这有点像个象征性的举动……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Rachel! That was a library card!
lines.zh: 瑞秋！那是张借书卡！

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Cut, cut, cut, cut, cut, cut, cut..
lines.zh: 剪，剪，剪，剪，剪，剪，剪……

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: You know, if you listen closely, you can hear a thousand retailers scream.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，如果仔细听，你能听到一千个零售商在尖叫。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Welcome to the real world! It sucks. You're gonna love it!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到现实世界！它糟糕透了。但你会爱上它的！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Well, that's it. You gonna crash on the couch?
lines.zh: 好了，就这样。你要睡沙发吗？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No. No, I gotta go home sometime.
lines.zh: 不。不，我总得回家。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: You be okay?
lines.zh: 你会没事吧？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Yeah.
lines.zh: 会的。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Hey Mon, look what I just found on the floor. What?
lines.zh: 嘿莫，看我在地板上找到了什么。怎么了？

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: That's Paul's watch. You just put it back where you found it. Oh boy. Alright. Goodnight, everybody.
lines.zh: 那是保罗的手表。你就放回原处。噢天。好了。晚安，各位。

lines.speaker: Ross and Rachel
lines.text: Goodnight.
lines.zh: 晚安。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Mmm. Oh, no-
lines.zh: 嗯。噢，不——

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Sorry-
lines.zh: 抱歉——

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: No no no, go-
lines.zh: 不不不，你拿——

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: No, you have it, really, I don't want it-
lines.zh: 不，你拿，真的，我不想要——

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Split it?
lines.zh: 分了？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Okay.
lines.zh: 好。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay. You know you probably didn't know this, but back in high school, I had a, um, major crush on you.
lines.zh: 好。你可能不知道，高中的时候，我，嗯，超级喜欢你。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I knew.
lines.zh: 我知道。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: You did! Oh.... I always figured you just thought I was Monica's geeky older brother.
lines.zh: 你知道！噢……我一直以为你只当我是莫妮卡那个书呆子哥哥。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I did.
lines.zh: 我确实这么想。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Oh. Listen, do you think- and try not to let my intense vulnerability become any kind of a factor here- but do you think it would be okay if I asked you out? Sometime? Maybe?
lines.zh: 噢。听着，你觉得——尽量别让我强烈的脆弱成为任何因素——但你觉得如果我约你出去可以吗？有空的时候？也许？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Yeah, maybe...
lines.zh: 嗯，也许……

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Okay... okay, maybe I will...
lines.zh: 好……好，也许我会……

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Goodnight.
lines.zh: 晚安。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: Goodnight.
lines.zh: 晚安。

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: See ya.... Waitwait, what's with you?
lines.zh: 再见……等等等等，你怎么了？

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: I just grabbed a spoon.
lines.zh: 我刚刚拿起了勺子。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: I can't believe what I'm hearing here.
lines.zh: 我不敢相信我听到的。

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I can't believe what I'm hearing here...
lines.zh: 我不敢相信我听到的……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: What? I-I said you had a-
lines.zh: 什么？我——我说你有个——

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What I said you had...
lines.zh: 我说过你有……

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: Would you stop?
lines.zh: 你能停吗？

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, was I doing it again?
lines.zh: 噢，我又在那样做了吗？

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yes!
lines.zh: 是的！

lines.speaker: Monica
lines.text: I said that you had a nice butt, it's just not a great butt.
lines.zh: 我说你屁股不错，只是不是超级棒的屁股。

lines.speaker: Joey
lines.text: Oh, you wouldn't know a great butt if it came up and bit ya.
lines.zh: 噢，就算超级棒的屁股跑过来咬你，你也认不出来。

lines.speaker: Ross
lines.text: There's an image.
lines.zh: 真有画面感。

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Would anybody like more coffee?
lines.zh: 有人要再来点咖啡吗？

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Did you make it, or are you just serving it?
lines.zh: 是你做的，还是只是端上来的？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: I'm just serving it.
lines.zh: 只是端上来的。

lines.speaker: All
lines.text: Yeah. Yeah, I'll have a cup of coffee.
lines.zh: 好。好，我要一杯咖啡。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Kids, new dream... I'm in Las Vegas.
lines.zh: 孩子们，新梦……我在拉斯维加斯。

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Uh, miss? More coffee?
lines.zh: 呃，小姐？再来点咖啡？

lines.speaker: Rachel
lines.text: Ugh. Excuse me, could you give this to that guy over there? Go ahead. Thank you. Sorry. Okay, Las Vegas.
lines.zh: 呃。不好意思，能把这个给那边那个人吗？去吧。谢谢。抱歉。好了，拉斯维加斯。

lines.speaker: Chandler
lines.text: Okay, so, I'm in Las Vegas... I'm Liza Minelli.
lines.zh: 好，那么，我在拉斯维加斯……我是丽莎·明尼利。
